svg.title: System specifications
svg.desc: CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X. GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 AERO 8GB. RAM: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB (2x16GB) DDR4. Motherboard: Gigabyte B550M DS3H. Displays: two 1920x1080 displays; Samsung S22D300 at 60Hz. OS: CachyOS x86_64. Desktop: KDE Plasma on Wayland, Breeze theme, Papirus-Dark icons.
